fact: The terms of reference state the Epicor-based IFMIS is currently used by all Lesotho ministries and councils and by foreign missions in South Africa and Ethiopia (document undated; published date 2026-08-26 used).
The World Bank PID states the IFMIS was upgraded in 2019 and is in use, though key processes still take place outside it and unreconciled transactions keep growing.

The World Bank appraisal document states the IFMIS, upgraded in 2019, has its budget and treasury modules active, though the core system is often unavailable because of network problems (document published 2023-12-22, used as the date).

The World Bank appraisal document states a Human Resource Management Information System is in place and its payroll module is in use, with most other modules little used (document published 2023-12-22, used as the date).

Revenue Services Lesotho's guide of 6 February 2025 describes its e-Taxation platform, on which taxpayers register, file and amend company, individual, VAT and PAYE returns and pay through the e-Payments system by mobile money or bank.
